issues.description: The problem statement asks dd_get_amplitude to "return the probability corresponding to the given bitstring as a float" (i.e., a probability), but both the provided template and the reference solution define dd_get_amplitude to return the amplitude (a complex value) and their docstrings/state indicate it should return an amplitude. This mismatch in the expected return value (probability vs amplitude / complex vs float) will confuse students about the correct implementation and type to return.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification: either (A) change the problem statement to request the amplitude (complex value) for dd_get_amplitude (matching the template and solution and the task name 'Get amplitude'), or (B) change the template and solution to return the probability (squared magnitude as a float) and update docstrings/tests accordingly. Preferred fix: update problem_statement.md to request the amplitude (complex) and clarify its type in the description so students implement a complex amplitude return value.
